fixes.what: Extract the `[data-accordion]` click/hover/focus handler block and move it above `if (!motion) { return; }` (line 111).
fixes.why: Currently, users with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (or if GSAP fails to load) cannot open collapsed desktop accordion panels because the event listeners are skipped.

fixes.what: Add `.site-header--over.nav-open { background: var(--cream); color: var(--brown); }` and ensure `.site-header--over.nav-open .site-logo__red { display: block; }` / `.site-logo__cream { display: none; }`.
fixes.why: If a mobile user opens the navigation menu at the very top of `index.html` before scrolling, the drawer is cream but the header bar above it stays transparent with cream icons.

fixes.what: Add `aria-hidden="false"` to the open `.accordion__body` and toggle `aria-hidden` (or the `hidden` attribute) on `.accordion__body` inside `site.js` when panels open/close on desktop.
fixes.why: On desktop, closed accordion panels only hide their `.accordion__body` via `opacity: 0`, leaving collapsed text exposed to screen readers alongside `aria-expanded="false"`.

fixes.what: Add an AJAX submit handler in `site.js` for `.form` using `fetch(form.action, { method: 'POST', body: new FormData(form), headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })` with inline status/error messaging.
fixes.why: Provides graceful in-page feedback and error handling without forcing a full-page redirect away from the site.

fixes.what: Preload `TTRamillas-Regular.woff2` in `<head>` alongside Bold, or verify font-weight usage across body copy vs. the trial font files.
fixes.why: `body` defaults to `font-weight: 400` (`TTRamillas-Regular.woff2`), while only `TTRamillas-Bold.woff2` is preloaded in `<head>`, risking a brief FOUT on body paragraphs.
